name: com.flagsense.android.listener.FSConnectivityReceiver
description: When Android reports a connectivity change, this FlagSense receiver checks internet access and tells the SDK when the connection changes; the SDK starts or stops feature-flag polling and experiment-event uploads.
disableEffect: FlagSense will not pause or restart its polling and event services when internet connectivity changes, so remote flag data or experiment events may become stale or delayed.
